catch will all be recorded.

Check to see how
many kinds exist.
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text:
The RUINS are
about 1500 years old.

But it's not known
why they were built--or by whom.
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_:
I wonder how many
kinds of #MON are in the RUINS?

#MON appeared
in the RUINS?

That's incredible
news!

We'll need to
investigate this.

Our investigation,
with your help, is

giving us insight
into the RUINS.

The RUINS appear
to have been built

as a habitat for
#MON.
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text:
There are odd pat-
terns drawn on the

walls of the
RUINS.

They must be the
keys for unravel- ing the mystery of the RUINS.
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_:
The strange #-
MON you saw in the RUINS?

They appear to be
very much like the

drawings on the
walls there.

Hmm…

That must mean
there are many kinds of them…
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnusedText1:
We think something
caused the cryptic

patterns to appear
in the RUINS.

We've focused our
studies on that.
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnusedText2:
According to my
research…

Those mysterious
patterns appeared

when the #COM
CENTER was built.

It must mean that
radio waves have

some sort of a
link…
RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_:
Why did those
ancient patterns

appear on the wall
now?

The mystery
deepens…
